v1_disposition.defect: The up/down event classifier typed Polymarket's 5m, 15m and 1h series identically as direction_1h. Consequences: (a) v1 placed 36/40 forward orders on direction_5m markets — the known fee-negative cell — via duplicate mislabeled in-memory records; (b) the v1 discovery cohort labeled '1h' was actually 90% fifteen-minute markets (36/40) with window_start stored 45 minutes early.
v1_disposition.v1_rows: All rows under experiment research-h52-hourly-neareven-favorite-v1 and strategy H52_hourly_neareven_favorite_v1 are excluded from every H52 read forever.
v1_disposition.fixes: Classifier now types by slug (research-universe.js directionMarketType); 5m slugs are excluded from this discovery path entirely; borg_markets rows relabeled direction_15m with corrected window_start/timeframe/resolution_source; klines re-anchored on exact 1m candles.

hypothesis: In fifteen-minute up/down markets during the final 60-300 seconds, the favorite token quoted 0.50-0.60 at the executable ask is systematically underpriced, because quoting attention concentrates on the 5-minute series and the 15-minute books go stale near resolution.

discovery_evidence.method: Retrospective borg_book_snaps calibration, one snapshot per resolved market (first with tte 60-300s), favorite = higher best ask, executable ask entry, crypto taker fee 0.07*p*(1-p) per share.
discovery_evidence.window: 2026-07-17 01:14Z through 2026-07-18 (the entire snapshot dataset — two days; this is NOT a robustness split)
discovery_evidence.negative_control: Identical cell on direction_5m: n=1,720, win rate 0.528, -0.033/share at 1x.
discovery_evidence.independent_verification: report-h52-verifier-2026-07-18.md — key findings incorporated: entries cluster (34 distinct timestamps; correlated same-minute cross-asset pairs); clustered p approximately 0.039-0.059 against the book-implied favorite probability 0.542; under a >=52-hypothesis search this is consistent with pure selection. tte sub-window structure is non-monotone (zigzag) — the earlier 'later entry is stronger' claim is retracted. Displacement-robustness claims are struck (btc_ref column was broken; reference candles were poisoned at analysis time). Band-edge decay is smooth (0.194 at 0.50-0.55 falling to 0.012 at 0.60-0.70), stale-book/fee/tick/coverage attacks failed, delayed-fill simulation at +5/10/30s holds approximately +0.14.
known_weaknesses: Two capture days = the entire dataset; no across-regime evidence exists.
Post-selection band and window; clustered significance is marginal and consistent with search artifacts.
sol subgroup negative in-sample (-0.021 over ask 0.50-0.70) — treated as noise, not excluded.
Median displayed touch depth ~$130 per entry; capacity is tiny.
About 17% of v1 forward orders were marked unfilled by the execution model — displayed asks are not always takeable.

frozen_mechanics.favorite_definition: side with the strictly higher best ask; equal asks skip
frozen_mechanics.execution: single taker buy of the favorite at the displayed ask, latency_1s execution model, 20% displayed-touch participation, TARGET_STAKE_USD stake, once per market, hold to terminal resolution; strategy-level market_type guard in addition to engine dispatch

registered_prediction: If the mechanism is real, forward mean net P&L per entered market is positive at 2x costs. If the discovery was selection, the arm converges to approximately -1x fees per market (about -$0.20 per $10 stake).

cluster_by: entry timestamp minute (cross-asset co-entries are one cluster)
evaluation.multiple_testing: Correct across the full H1-H52 research family and every discarded variant.
evaluation.early_kill: If mean net_pnl_2x per entered market is at or below zero at 100 independent direction_15m markets, stop the arm and record the negative result.
evaluation.overlap_rule: Markets also entered by any other 15m/1h arm must be reported jointly; do not sum overlapping arms as independent profit.
evaluation.promotion: No live path. Passing the mechanical read only triggers a separate implementation and risk review.
evaluation.null_outcome: Measured edge may be approximately zero; no parameter or inverse signal may be selected from the discovery cohort.
